title: Font Panel (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Font Panel applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Font Panel (BtnFontPanel) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Font Panel apply decisions (size bounds, change detection, culture parsing) pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production decision rules pin: font sizes are exclusive-bounded (0 and 4000+ rejected, 0.01 and 3999.99 accepted); the size-change detection uses an inclusive no-change boundary at exactly the 0.01 epsilon while float reality makes 12 -> 12.01 a change; the name comparison is case-insensitive and treats a missing name as a change; typed size text parses in the user's culture (de-DE '12,5' and en-US '12.5' both work, non-numeric input is rejected). FontPanel delegates all three rules instead of inlining them (both call sites included).
